decisions.reason: As a consumer superfood product far from the firm's industrial waste-to-value core and no longer seen on the website after 2019, it is very likely to be discontinued.
Although modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the engineering portfolio, two years without website presence suggest the line was likely folded into custom project work or deprioritized.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant matches the firm's strategic direction, but its disappearance from the website despite being an earlier flagship points to likely withdrawal of the standalone offer.
Plastic-waste-to-fuel remains strategically adjacent yet carries higher commercialization risk, and its absence from the website indicates management would likely reallocate resources elsewhere.
